title: [GR-41675] Only require libmanagement_ext if it's actually needed.

timeline.body:
On some systems/apps, libawt_headless gets pulled in. This currently brings in libmanagement_ext unconditionally. However, libmanagement_ext should only be present for linking iff
com.sun.management.internal.OperatingSystemImpl class becomes reachable. The fix is to only add `management_ext` as a dependency for `awt_headless` when class `OperatingSystemImpl` is actually reachable.

Closes: #5119
LGTM, although I don't really understand why we need to add `management_ext` twice in the first place.
Instead of using a field, we can't check somehow that "management_ext" is already added?

reply.body: OK. Done now. It requires iterating over the internal list of static libraries, though (using `NativeLibraries`).

timeline.body:
I think it would be simpler to just check if the `com.sun.management.internal.OperatingSystemImpl` class is reachable.
```suggestion
        boolean managementExtNeeded = access.isReachable(clazz(access, "com.sun.management.internal.OperatingSystemImpl"));
```

reply.body: Thanks, done in the latest version.
